event.distribution_pattern: New York, New Jersey and Virginia

products.product_description: Assorted Milk Chocolate Royal Icing Pops sold as Assorted Character Icing Pops, Christmas Icing Pops, and Triple Heart Icing Pops, 24 pops per box. The Milk Chocolate Icing Pops are made to order and sold in unmarked bulk boxes. Each Milk Chocolate Icing Pop is individually wrapped for retail sale in 2 oz. clear cellophane with a curl ribbon closure.
products.reason_for_recall: The products contain undeclared egg and FD&C colors Yellow 5 or 6, Red 3 or 40, and/or Blue 1 from the royal icing component used on the finished pops.
